title: Does the grand coalition form?
text:
Status: AI-assisted work in progress



This paper was developed with substantial AI assistance. It is currently undergoing formalization in Lean 4, which has already exposed errors in earlier versions. Results, including ones stated as theorems, may still change.
Preprint: arXiv:2608.17766 (v1 18 Aug 2026, v2 23 Aug 2026) · PDF

title: Does the grand coalition form?
text:
Summary
Players repeatedly form and dissolve nested binding agreements and evaluate outcomes by discounted long-run payoffs. The paper asks whether the grand coalition persists once reached and whether it is eventually reached, and how the answer depends on the rule for sharing the surplus. See the arXiv abstract for the precise statements.
